purpose: Rootward v0.6 art-direction comparison only; no implementation decision
shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one landscape 16:9 in-game art-direction mockup for Rootward v0.6, a cozy fantasy village programming game. This is a new concept scene, not a literal edit of the reference screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is the current Kindle Hollow screenshot: reference for world identity, palette, auburn-haired teal-clothed player and firefly companion. Image 2 is the approved cottage: reference for warm wood, pale stone, violet/slate shingles, friendly fantasy architecture and material character. Apply the requested camera below even when it differs from these references.
Shared scene for a fair three-way comparison: a compact inhabited Kindle Hollow village fills the entire screen, with continuous ground extending beyond the frame. A violet-roof timber-and-stone cottage toward the upper left, a teal-roof watermill at upper right on a brook, a cobbled green in the middle with four lantern posts, a short wooden bridge and an open timber gate crossing the brook toward the lower right, a loaded handcart and twelve sacks near the mill, and a small jar shelf against a workshop. A handful of substantial trees frame the clearing. Keep navigable paths wide and clear. Place the auburn-haired player in teal with brown boots near the central lamp and the tiny glowing fairy beside their shoulder; two residents nearby. All human characters are clean, readable small game sprites, roughly three heads tall, consistent scale, distinct clothing silhouettes and intentional anatomy. Comparable world density, polish, framing and daytime lighting across variants. Warm wood, cream stone, muted violet and teal roofs, rich restrained greens, amber lanterns and blue-green water.
Show the world reacting to code: the four lamps are warmly lit, the gate is open, one lamp has a thin amber selection outline; this is a quiet readable effect, not magical circuitry. Small tasteful charcoal-and-gold UI, world occupying most of the image: tiny top-left place name "Kindle Hollow", small top-right objective "Light the green"; a compact bottom-left code card occupies no more than one quarter of screen width, title "Village logic", two readable illustrative lines "for lamp in green.lamps:" and "    lamp.set_lit(True)", a small "Run" button and status "World updated". Code here is visual mockup text. No other large text. The scene must look like a playable game at normal camera distance, not a promotional painting.
Avoid: split panels, triptych, collage, title poster, floating island, exposed diorama slab, toy pedestal, photorealism, heavy depth of field, extreme bloom, massive buildings hiding the player, busy particle effects, sci-fi computers or neon circuit paths, noisy tiny details, mismatched character scales, visible game-engine editor.

images.title: 1 · Isometric, with the current visual character
images.prompt: DIRECTION 1 — TWO-DIMENSIONAL ISOMETRIC SPRITE ART. Reinterpret this village as a classic high-quality 2D isometric/dimetric RPG view. Diamond-shaped ground cells, streets follow diagonal ground axes about plus/minus 30 degrees, fixed elevated camera: see two wall faces and the roof of every building with consistent parallel projection. Paint the buildings and terrain as crisp textured pixel-inspired raster sprites with fine controlled clusters and plum outlines, following the illustrated warm fantasy material style of the approved cottage. Organic rounded foliage and hand-shaped masonry; not cubes and not voxel art. Character sprites are cleaner, simpler and more readable than the screenshot, facing naturally along the diagonal streets. Crisp coherent sprite rendering, no blur. Give the buildings convincing volume while keeping the cozy pixel-art identity.

images.title: 2 · Voxel-style isometric, with clean sprite characters
images.prompt: DIRECTION 2 — VOXEL-INSPIRED MODULAR 3D ENVIRONMENT WITH SPRITE CHARACTERS. Fixed orthographic elevated isometric camera, diagonal street axes and two visible wall faces per building. Construct the same cozy fantasy buildings, banks, bridge, walls, trees and props from clear chunky volumetric voxel-like modules: stepped block tree canopies, solid squared stone courses, broad block timber beams, simplified stepped violet and teal roof tiles. Read as real three-dimensional assembled forms with consistent soft contact shadows and restrained ambient occlusion. Attractive art-directed voxel style, not a Minecraft screenshot, not smooth plastic, not photorealistic and not a fine-grained noisy voxel sculpture. Preserve cream stone, warm timber and the friendly roofs of the reference. The player and the two residents remain clean expressive illustrated/pixel sprite characters standing upright in the 3D scene, clearly readable silhouettes and grounded feet; do not make them anonymous cubic Minecraft people. This image should make coherent, manipulatable environment components feel tangible. Same modest flat village and brook banks; no giant cliffs or extra spectacular content to bias the comparison.

images.title: 3 · The current 2D view, brought to a future visual target
images.prompt: DIRECTION 3 — POLISHED EVOLUTION OF THE EXISTING ORTHOGONAL 2D GAME. Preserve the current game's elevated front-facing RPG camera: world roads run horizontal and vertical on a square ground grid, buildings face screen-bottom with a broad front facade and roof receding toward screen-top, side wall hidden. Do not rotate this into a diamond/isometric grid. A complete future-goal asset pass in the approved cottage's warm crisp fantasy pixel-inspired raster style: convincingly thick roof planes, deep eaves, recessed doors and windows, layered stone bases, rich but restrained contact shadows, carefully separated material planes. Improve depth and cohesion within flat sprite rendering. Foliage uses deliberate readable clusters, paths blend naturally into grass, every prop shares the same camera and detail scale. Cleaner human sprites with readable faces and silhouettes, restrained outlines, consistent anatomy and walking direction, like a refined future version of the reference. No cubical voxel geometry. Give it the same polish and village density as the two alternative directions.
